# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher at the Carmody school (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses real showy looks, characterized by a plump and striking figure. She has large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and wears her hair in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who frankly enjoys the pleasant things of life, though she is inclined to be hysterical. She is preoccupied with romance, obsessed with young men, and frequently talks about the boys who are crazy about her and the compliments they give. Driven by a desire for male attention, her ambitions include having numerous beaus, securing a beau by age fifteen, and teaching for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many big sisters and once famously charmed away all her warts using a magic pebble. As a schoolgirl in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she joined a story club formed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). She later became part of Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. By the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepared to leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Ruby had received a marriage proposal from Nelson Atkins three weeks prior.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are long-time schoolmates who share gifts and tokens of appreciation to express their friendship. They regularly gather with their local peers for outdoor activities like picking Mayflowers and social events. Their shared social circle also involves playing together and participating in dares, such as the gathering where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fell from a roof.

- Friend of — schoolmates who exchange gifts and tokens of appreciation  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) are old mutual friends within the same close social circle in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They frequently gather together with their shared friends, including [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), to socialize and catch up on local news.

- Friend of — old friends who get together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
